clue.text: Took someone else's place when offered again

definitions.meaning: stood in for another person, acted on their behalf

explanation.surface: Someone deputised for a colleague when a role came round a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: To act as a delegate or stand-in is to represent, while presenting once more is re-presenting; the two spellings coincide.

clue.text: Engineers with a sound training

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army corps
a ring is a sound, as of a bell

explanation.surface: Engineers undergoing proper, thorough training.
explanation.definitionFit: Rearing is bringing up and schooling a child or animal, a kind of upbringing.

clue.text: Boys in books

definitions.meaning: page boys, young attendants or servants
the leaves found in any book

explanation.definitionFit: Young servants are called page boys, and the leaves of a volume are also its pages.

clue.text: The princess designated touching craft

parts.note: elect means chosen or designated but not yet in office
re means concerning or touching on
SS, steamship, stands for a vessel or craft

explanation.surface: A princess chosen to touch a ship, perhaps at its launch.
explanation.definitionFit: An electress was the wife of a German elector, a princess of the Holy Roman Empire.

clue.text: A country one has entered before

indicators.note: one piece is said to have gone into another, so it sits inside it

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A traveller remarks on a land they have visited before.
explanation.definitionFit: Eire is the Irish-language name for the Republic of Ireland, a nation.

clue.text: Such accommodation as the workers get in principle

indicators.note: the workers get into the other word, so they sit inside it

parts.note: a tenet is a principle or belief
men is a crossword stock word for workers or hands

explanation.surface: Housing of the kind labourers are given, at least in theory.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenement is a block of rented flats, historically housing for working families.

clue.text: Many vain characters will obtain a seat

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a crossword stand-in for many

indicators.note: the letters of vain are treated as loose characters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Lots of conceited people will grab somewhere to sit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'characters' rearranges VAIN into IVAN, which follows D.
explanation.definitionFit: A divan is a low backless couch or sofa used for sitting.

clue.text: Don't exercise so much — it's futile

definitions.meaning: an instruction to employ something less

explanation.definitionFit: Futile means pointless, of no use at all, and the advice to employ less reads the same when split.

clue.text: Poet reflecting on the head's gloomy look

indicators.note: a reflection is a mirror image, so the word for poet is read backwards

parts.note: a bard is a poet
a ness is a headland or promontory

explanation.surface: A poet broods on the gloomy expression of a headmaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Drabness is dullness or dreariness, a cheerless appearance.

clue.text: Support for a fishermen's club?

definitions.meaning: an L-shaped steel bar used as a structural brace
an iron is a golf club, and anglers are fishermen

explanation.definitionFit: An L-section metal bar used as a brace is angle iron, and playfully an angler's golf club.

clue.text: Some couples never get on edge

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the joined pair of words are taken, run together

explanation.surface: Certain married pairs never manage to get along.
explanation.definitionFit: A verge is a border or brink, as of a road or a lawn.

clue.text: Lets in favoured cliques

definitions.meaning: puts something into a larger thing, as a picture into a page

explanation.definitionFit: To inset is to insert or set in, and the in-crowd's groups are sets that are in.

clue.text: Expert holding mean bungler liable

indicators.note: one word holds the other inside it

parts.note: able means skilled or expert

indicators.note: a bungler messes things up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A specialist is keeping hold of a stingy, clumsy person who is to blame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bungler' jumbles MEAN into MENA, which 'holding' puts inside ABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Amenable can mean answerable or subject to, as amenable to the law.

clue.text: Note the conductor is a really effusive individual

parts.note: G is a musical note
an usher conducts people to their seats

explanation.surface: A remark that the orchestra's maestro is extremely gushing.
explanation.definitionFit: A gusher is a person who talks with excessive enthusiasm, like an oil well spouting.

clue.text: The eccentric declines to be kept quiet

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An odd person says no and is hushed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Silenced means hushed or made to stop speaking.

clue.text: Releases by turns

parts.note: frees something not alternately but by twisting a threaded fastener round

explanation.definitionFit: Undoing a screw frees a part through repeated twisting.

clue.text: The spare room

parts.note: not a guest bedroom but space left free, the gap allowed between things

explanation.definitionFit: A gap or margin left between objects, such as headroom under a bridge, is this.

clue.text: Give voice about employment in a fairground attraction

indicators.note: one word goes round the other

parts.note: to carol is to sing joyfully
use means employment, as in putting to use

explanation.surface: Someone sings while working on a fairground ride.
explanation.definitionFit: A carousel is a merry-go-round, a revolving ride at a fair.

clue.text: Giving firm order, including the French salad

indicators.note: the first pieces include the French word within them

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm
law means order, as in law and order
les is French for the (plural)

explanation.surface: A boss orders a French dish in a firm voice.
explanation.definitionFit: Coleslaw is a dish of shredded raw cabbage in dressing.

clue.text: An apple for small fry

definitions.meaning: a long, tapering variety of cooking apple
a young cod, a small fish

explanation.definitionFit: A codling is both a cooking apple variety and a young cod.

clue.text: Poles interrupt beasts, and that's not so bright!

indicators.note: the poles break into the middle of the animals' word

parts.note: deer are beasts
N and S, north and south, are the poles

explanation.surface: Polish people barge in on animals, and that is rather dim.
explanation.definitionFit: Denser can mean stupider, thicker in the head, less clever.

clue.text: Turned to trade possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Switched to commerce, maybe.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotated means spun or revolved.

clue.text: Serve the people present

parts.note: to do time is to serve a sentence
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Wait on the people who are in attendance.
explanation.definitionFit: A donation is a gift, something given to a cause.

clue.text: They may well act incisively, naturally

definitions.text: They may well act incisively, naturally

parts.words: They may well act incisively, naturally
parts.note: incisors cut, so these are natural biting tools rather than sharp-minded people

explanation.definitionFit: Incisors are front cutting tools in the mouth.

clue.text: Port is drunk for good health

indicators.note: drunk means the letters are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: A fortified wine is downed as a toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosit is a toast, Latin for may it benefit, said when drinking to someone.

clue.text: Mind greatly about a letter being returned

indicators.note: one word goes around the other

parts.note: so means very or greatly

indicators.note: returned means the letter's spelling is read backwards

parts.note: tee is the spelt-out name of the letter T

explanation.surface: Pay close attention when a letter comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being returned' turns TEE into EET, which SO goes 'about'.
explanation.definitionFit: To see to something is to attend to it or take care of it.

clue.text: The song of the vegetarian section

indicators.note: only a section of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A tune that belongs to the vegetarian part of the menu.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo piece in an opera.

clue.text: A woman causing ill-feeling-one lacking nothing

parts.note: ire means anger

indicators.note: the word is without the letter for nothing

parts.note: O looks like a zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A woman who stirs up resentment, someone with nothing to offer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' removes O from ONE, leaving NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Irene is a girl's name.

clue.text: A row between holy men would be most surprising

indicators.note: the row sits between the two saints

parts.note: St is short for saint, a holy man; two are needed
St is short for saint, a holy man; two are needed
a range is a row, as of mountains

explanation.surface: A quarrel among monks would be very shocking.
explanation.definitionFit: Strangest means oddest, most unusual.

clue.text: Adjusting of scale taken in hand-but not for long

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are taken into the other word

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: adjusting means changing the order of these letters

explanation.surface: Fiddling with a set of weighing scales held in the hand, but only briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Adjusting' rearranges OF SCALE into LFASECO, which goes inside HAND after HA.
explanation.definitionFit: A moment, a very brief instant of time.
